title: Authoritative Payment Policy Reconciliation & Capability Matrix
policy_summary: The active, approved frontend policy on https://mect.org.in/ is direct State Bank of India bank transfer and static UPI QR code with manual UTR submission via DonationClaimSection.tsx. Commercial payment gateways (Cashfree, Razorpay) and self-hosted engines (HIM/UPIHost) remain dormant/inactive in production.

capability_matrix.details: Active on /donate via BankingTable.tsx and src/config/org.ts. Direct transfer to SBI Account ending in ****2498, IFSC SBIN0001701.
Active on /donate via UpiQrCard.tsx (VPA 86971610172@sbi) and DonationClaimSection.tsx dispatching to /api/donations/claim.
Fully implemented in CashfreePaymentGatewayService.java and V10 migration. Frontend unmounted. Requires explicit owner decision and production API credentials to activate.
Present in RazorpayPaymentGatewayService.java from legacy codebase. Unconfigured, no frontend interface, no production authorization.
Implemented in HimPaymentGatewayService.java and V12 migration. production-enabled flag defaults to false. Dormant.
Implemented in CashfreePaymentController with HMAC verification and idempotency protection. Inactive while gateway is inactive.
Active for manual SBI UTR verification. DonationLifecycleService generates canonical receipts upon admin review.
